alternative.sql: SELECT row_id, CASE WHEN json_type(payload, '$') IS DISTINCT FROM 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.collection_status'), 'collected') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty') OR coalesce(json_type(payload, '$._coverage'), 'OBJECT') <> 'OBJECT' OR json_type(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig') IS DISTINCT FROM 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig.collection_status'), 'collected') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty') OR coalesce(json_type(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig._coverage'), 'OBJECT') <> 'OBJECT' OR (json_type(payload, '$._coverage.shieldedInstanceConfig') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(payload, '$._coverage.shieldedInstanceConfig') <> 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$._coverage.shieldedInstanceConfig.status'), 'unknown') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty'))) OR (json_type(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig._coverage.enableVtpm') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig._coverage.enableVtpm') <> 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig._coverage.enableVtpm.status'), 'unknown') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty'))) OR coalesce(json_type(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig.enableVtpm'), 'NULL') NOT IN ('BOOLEAN') THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN json_extract_string(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig.enableVtpm') IN ('true') THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status, json_extract(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig.enableVtpm') AS configured FROM facts ORDER BY row_id

'$.properties.collection_status'), 'collected') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty') OR coalesce(json_type(payload, '$.properties._coverage'), 'OBJECT') <> 'OBJECT' OR json_type(payload, coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.properties.parameters.enableNoPublicIp.collection_status'), 'collected') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty') OR coalesce(json_type(payload, '$.properties.parameters.enableNoPublicIp._coverage'), 'OBJECT') <> 'OBJECT' OR (json_type(payload, '$._coverage.properties') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(payload, '$._coverage.properties') <> 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$._coverage.properties.status'), 'unknown') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty'))) OR (json_type(payload, '$.properties._coverage.parameters') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(payload, '$.properties._coverage.parameters') <> 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.properties._coverage.parameters.status'), 'unknown') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty'))) OR (json_type(payload, '$.properties.parameters._coverage.enableNoPublicIp') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(payload, '$.properties.parameters._coverage.enableNoPublicIp') <> 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.properties.parameters._coverage.enableNoPublicIp.status'), 'unknown') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty'))) OR (json_type(payload, '$.properties.parameters.enableNoPublicIp._coverage.value') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(payload, '$.properties.parameters.enableNoPublicIp._coverage.value') <> 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.properties.parameters.enableNoPublicIp._coverage.value.status'), 'unknown') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty'))) OR coalesce(json_type(payload, '$.properties.parameters.enableNoPublicIp.value'), 'NULL') NOT IN ('BOOLEAN') THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN json_extract_string(payload, '$.properties.parameters.enableNoPublicIp.value') IN ('true') THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status, json_extract(payload, '$.properties.parameters.enableNoPublicIp.value') AS configured FROM facts ORDER BY row_id

checks.remediation: Register the required hardware MFA device for root and retain account recovery options.

caveats: This check is commercial-partition only and ignores root without a password or active key. Any virtual device whose User.Arn contains root fails even if hardware MFA is also enrolled; never remove the current factor before testing the replacement.

steps: Register the required hardware MFA device for root and retain account recovery options.
remediation_details.summary: Register the required hardware MFA device for root and retain account recovery options.

checks.rationale: For commercial-partition root accounts with credentials, checks account MFA and whether root has a virtual device; hardware MFA is required by this source.
checks.description: For commercial-partition root accounts with credentials, checks account MFA and whether root has a virtual device; hardware MFA is required by this source.
checks.pass_when: PASS when AccountMFAEnabled is positive and no root virtual MFA device is found.
checks.fail_when: FAIL when credentialed root has AccountMFAEnabled zero or a root virtual MFA device is found.
checks.not_applicable_when: Non-commercial partitions, or a root row without a password or active access key.

severity_review.reason: The criterion conflates missing MFA with a virtual-versus-hardware assurance preference; root MFA absence is high risk, while a virtual-only mismatch should be reviewed conditionally.

AWS states new AppSync caches always enable at-rest and in-transit encryption; CloudFormation marks the encryption properties deprecated and replacement-required. Review the actual owner plan and service version before applying.

caveats: Only Engine=docdb clusters are evaluated; the exact predicate reads the cluster StorageEncrypted boolean. Encryption cannot be enabled in place on an existing unencrypted cluster.

AWS DocumentDB cannot encrypt an unencrypted cluster snapshot by copying it with KmsKeyId; that CopyDBClusterSnapshot request returns an error. Restore the unencrypted snapshot as a new cluster with a KMS key instead.

Restore creates a new cluster without DB instances and can default to the default security group unless the complete network/configuration is supplied. controls.framework: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0

checks.remediation: Replace certificates using the flagged algorithms after checking client compatibility and rollout procedures.

caveats: Only certificates with nonempty InUseBy are evaluated. The failure set is exactly RSA-1024 or P-192 after underscore-to-hyphen normalization; other algorithms pass this predicate even if a consuming service has narrower support.

ACM reimport cannot change a certificate's key type or size. Imported and ACM-issued certificates need a new certificate ARN with a supported stronger key and an explicit migration of each InUseBy association.

Changing TLS certificates can break clients or renewals. Validate domain names, chain, service-specific algorithms, ownership and rollback before switching associations; the old in-use ARN keeps failing until detached.

checks.title: AWS Private CA uses a post-quantum (ML-DSA) key algorithm
checks.remediation: Plan post-quantum migration where required, checking CA hierarchy, workload and client compatibility before replacement.

caveats: The evaluator skips only DELETED CAs; every other status fails unless CertificateAuthorityConfiguration.KeyAlgorithm is ML_DSA_44, ML_DSA_65 or ML_DSA_87. It does not test the signing algorithm or relying-party compatibility.

A CA key algorithm is chosen at creation. A replacement root or subordinate CA requires an owner-approved trust hierarchy, supported parent algorithm, certificate/profile compatibility, issuance migration and trust-store rollout; changing the CA can stop renewal or break validation.

AWS Private CA charges for additional CAs and issued certificates. Do not disable or delete the old CA until every dependent issuer, client and relying party has been migrated and rollback is documented.

This predicate applies only to ISSUED certificates and fails at the exact capture instant plus 30 days as well as earlier; other recognized statuses are NOT_APPLICABLE. Missing, denied, stale or incomplete inventory/detail remains UNKNOWN.

Multiarch indexes are UNKNOWN rather than sampling a platform; older images are outside scope. Digest integrity is checked transiently. Limits: 16 MiB actual per blob, 32 MiB actual per image, 64 MiB expanded and 5000 members across config/layers. Disabled unless content_secret_scans is strictly true. Files stay in memory; no archive extraction or code execution. ZIP/tar links, traversal, conflicting duplicates, encryption, unsupported compression, truncation and bounds yield UNKNOWN. Kingfisher SDK 1.4.0 and TruffleHog 3.92.5 inspect each bounded file without credential validation. Supplemental static indicators are retained. Identical secret values are merged across engines and locations using a collection-local keyed fingerprint; raw matches are discarded. A missing or failed engine prevents a complete negative verdict.

checks.title: Service account has no active unused-access insight
frameworks: NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)

controls.framework: NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)

checks.remediation: Confirm service account ownership and workloads before disabling obsolete identities or removing their grants.
checks.rationale: Reviews explicit ACTIVE SERVICE_ACCOUNT_USAGE insights from Google IAM Recommender. The current service account email and immutable numeric unique ID must both match, with at least 90 days of observation and a fresh insight. This captures provider-classified unused accounts even when no authentication timestamp exists; recent bound authentication contradicts an unused classification.
checks.description: Reviews explicit ACTIVE SERVICE_ACCOUNT_USAGE insights from Google IAM Recommender. The current service account email and immutable numeric unique ID must both match, with at least 90 days of observation and a fresh insight. This captures provider-classified unused accounts even when no authentication timestamp exists; recent bound authentication contradicts an unused classification.
checks.fail_when: A fresh ACTIVE unused-service-account insight names the current immutable service account identity with at least 90 days of observation and no contradictory bound recent authentication.
evaluated: current service account email, numeric unique ID and disabled state
ACTIVE SECURITY SERVICE_ACCOUNT_USAGE identity and target project
observationPeriod of at least 90 days and lastRefreshTime within three days
checks.not_applicable_when: The service account is disabled; missing, denied or inconsistent insight evidence remains unresolved.
checks.pass_when: A complete current insight inventory has no ACTIVE unused-usage insight matching the current service account identity.

A fresh insight covering at least 90 days and listing neither exercised nor inferred permissions identifies a grant with no provider-observed permission use; it is not a claim that every role permission can safely be removed.
checks.description: Reviews ACTIVE Google PERMISSIONS_USAGE insights against currently captured IAM grants. The resource, principal, role and condition expression must match. A fresh insight covering at least 90 days and listing neither exercised nor inferred permissions identifies a grant with no provider-observed permission use; it is not a claim that every role permission can safely be removed.

evaluated: exact native google.iam.policy.Insight request and identity
ACTIVE SECURITY PERMISSIONS_USAGE and 90-day observation duration
provider refresh within three days of capture
current resource IAM role, principal and condition expression
checks.not_applicable_when: A non-ACTIVE insight or another insight subtype is outside the permission-use predicate; missing or inconsistent evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
checks.pass_when: The current matching grant has at least one permission recorded as exercised in this insight.

checks.description: Reviews the latest recorded login on an individual enabled Google Directory user, using the immutable user ID rather than the potentially inaccurate users-list login field. Missing, sentinel or contradictory dates remain unresolved.

evaluated: current Directory user ID, email, customer, suspended and archived state

creationTime and lastLoginTime with a 90-day recorded-login threshold

checks.description: Identifies active federation-only workload identity pools without an enabled provider after complete current provider enumeration. checks.not_applicable_when: Disabled or deleted pools and managed-workload trust-domain pools are outside this external-provider predicate.

checks.title: API key has recent recorded successful requests
frameworks: NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)

controls.framework: NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)

checks.remediation: Review credential ownership, documented workloads and other activity sources before disabling an old recorded-activity candidate.
checks.rationale: Reviews the latest recorded successful Service Runtime API requests identified by the current API key UID in its verified owner project. Current credential identity, active/deleted state, creation time, project bindings, exact native metric query, daily aggregation and observation interval must match. An old recorded successful interval with complete selected views fails as a cleanup-review candidate; it does not establish universal credential inactivity. Empty metrics, failed requests alone and incomplete observations remain unresolved. Recent positive use can survive another selected view failure.
checks.description: Reviews the latest recorded successful Service Runtime API requests identified by the current API key UID in its verified owner project. Current credential identity, active/deleted state, creation time, project bindings, exact native metric query, daily aggregation and observation interval must match. An old recorded successful interval with complete selected views fails as a cleanup-review candidate; it does not establish universal credential inactivity. Empty metrics, failed requests alone and incomplete observations remain unresolved. Recent positive use can survive another selected view failure.
checks.fail_when: Complete selected metric views contain an older successful request interval and no newer successful interval within 90 days; empty series alone cannot fail and this is a recorded-activity review signal.
evaluated: current credential metadata identifier, owning project, creation time and active/deleted state
verified project ID/number bindings and selected project views
exact native Cloud Monitoring request filter, interval and aggregation
matching metric/resource/credential/project labels and successful response class
nonnegative daily request counts and timestamp bounds
checks.not_applicable_when: The HMAC key is inactive/deleted or the API key has a valid past deletion time; unknown usage remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
checks.pass_when: A matching successful request interval lies within the 90-day review period, or the credential was created within that period.

checks.title: Custom role has a declared grant in scoped IAM inventory
checks.remediation: Confirm role ownership and any supported-resource coverage gaps before deleting an obsolete custom role.
checks.rationale: Reviews current custom-role definitions for declared consumers in the owning project or organization. The role metadata must be fully read, project-number aliases independently verified, and the exact role must have no principal-bearing grant in the complete direct root policy and unfiltered paginated Cloud Asset scoped IAM search before it can fail. Scope restrictions and Cloud Asset supported-resource coverage remain explicit. This is structural cleanup evidence, not authentication history or a safe-deletion assertion.
checks.description: Reviews current custom-role definitions for declared consumers in the owning project or organization. The role metadata must be fully read, project-number aliases independently verified, and the exact role must have no principal-bearing grant in the complete direct root policy and unfiltered paginated Cloud Asset scoped IAM search before it can fail. Scope restrictions and Cloud Asset supported-resource coverage remain explicit. This is structural cleanup evidence, not authentication history or a safe-deletion assertion.
checks.fail_when: A current non-deleted custom role has no principal-bearing grant in the complete owning-scope version-3 IAM policy and unfiltered complete Cloud Asset IAM search.
evaluated: current role name, owner scope, deletion state and full includedPermissions metadata
exact native IAM roles.list FULL or roles.get source receipt
complete current owning-scope IAM policy requested with conditional policy version 3
unfiltered, unprojected paginated Cloud Asset searchAllIamPolicies and exact binding role/principals
checks.not_applicable_when: Google predefined roles, soft-deleted definitions, or roles referenced outside their owning scope; unproven project aliases remain UNKNOWN or DENIED.
checks.pass_when: A successful captured scoped IAM policy contains the current role with at least one declared principal; conditional grants remain declared consumers.

checks.title: Group inline policies have member identities
checks.remediation: Review group ownership and remove obsolete embedded policies after confirming the group has no intended consumers.
checks.rationale: Reviews inline policies embedded in current IAM groups for declared user consumers. A group with inline policies fails only when a complete account-wide GetAccountAuthorizationDetails user inventory contains no member of that group. The current group ARN, stable identity, native source, complete policy documents and membership projection are checked. A known current member is positive structural evidence even when unrelated user enumeration is partial. This is not authentication or action-use history, and no unused-day count is inferred.
checks.description: Reviews inline policies embedded in current IAM groups for declared user consumers. A group with inline policies fails only when a complete account-wide GetAccountAuthorizationDetails user inventory contains no member of that group. The current group ARN, stable identity, native source, complete policy documents and membership projection are checked. A known current member is positive structural evidence even when unrelated user enumeration is partial. This is not authentication or action-use history, and no unused-day count is inferred.
checks.fail_when: A current group has inline policies but a complete, valid account-wide IAM user inventory contains no member of that group.
evaluated: native group name, ARN, stable GroupId and matching account-wide projection
inline policy names and complete policy documents with action/resource clauses
native IAM user IDs, ARNs and complete GroupList values
complete user enumeration before absence; independent positive membership survives partial reads
checks.not_applicable_when: The current native group has no inline policy; missing or denied policy/membership evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
checks.pass_when: At least one current IAM user declares membership in the exact group with inline policies.

checks.title: Identity Center permission set has a consumer across organization accounts

checks.rationale: Reviews IAM Identity Center permission-set consumers across a complete organization account universe. Native Organizations account lists, instance/permission-set lists, all provisioning states and account assignments must be complete before reporting structural absence. Any verified assignment or provisioned account is a consumer. Denied, incomplete, inconsistent or foreign-scope evidence remains unresolved. This does not measure successful permission use or authorize deletion.
checks.description: Reviews IAM Identity Center permission-set consumers across a complete organization account universe. checks.fail_when: Complete native organization-wide account, assignment and provisioning reads found no current consumer.
evaluated: verified organization instance, owner account and native permission-set identity
all organization accounts including accounts without provisioned permission sets
unfiltered native provisioning lists and both latest-provisioning filters
paginated assignments in every organization account
checks.not_applicable_when: Unresolved home region, authority or missing organization account universe remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
checks.pass_when: A current bound assignment or provisioned account consumes this permission set.

checks.title: SAML provider has a role consumer
checks.remediation: Review provider ownership and remove obsolete federation providers after confirming intended consumers.
checks.rationale: Reviews current IAM SAML provider role consumers using complete account-wide native role trust inventory. An Allow trust statement naming the exact provider ARN with the matching STS federation action establishes a declared consumer even when conditions apply. Complete role enumeration and every valid trust document are required for structural absence; partial, denied, malformed, wildcard or negative-principal semantics leave absence unresolved. This does not measure authentication history or establish safe deletion.

wildcard, negative-principal, malformed or incomplete trust semantics
checks.not_applicable_when: Unavailable source or unsupported trust semantics remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
checks.pass_when: A current native role trust declares the exact provider and compatible STS federation action.

archived_checks.title: etcd trusts a CA file different from the kube-apiserver client CA
frameworks: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes

controls.framework: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes

archived_checks.remediation: Use a dedicated CA for etcd (--trusted-ca-file) distinct from the Kubernetes client CA.
archived_checks.rationale: Compares the etcd static Pod's --trusted-ca-file path with every kube-apiserver --client-ca-file path in the complete Pod inventory and FAILs when they are the same file. If etcd trusts the cluster client CA, any certificate issued for Kubernetes clients (including kubelets) can authenticate directly to etcd and read or rewrite all cluster state and Secrets. Differing paths are MANUAL because certificate contents are not compared.
archived_checks.description: Compares the etcd static Pod's --trusted-ca-file path with every kube-apiserver --client-ca-file path in the complete Pod inventory and FAILs when they are the same file. If etcd trusts the cluster client CA, any certificate issued for Kubernetes clients (including kubelets) can authenticate directly to etcd and read or rewrite all cluster state and Secrets. Differing paths are MANUAL because certificate contents are not compared.
archived_checks.pass_when: Never PASS automatically: distinct paths yield MANUAL for content comparison.
archived_checks.fail_when: The etcd trusted-ca-file path equals a kube-apiserver client-ca-file path.
archived_checks.not_applicable_when: When the Pod is not an etcd declaration, or the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

archived_checks.title: Kubelet configuration declares an x509 client CA file
frameworks: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes

controls.framework: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes

archived_checks.remediation: Set authentication.x509.clientCAFile in the kubelet configuration.
archived_checks.rationale: Flags a supplied kubelet configuration whose authentication block exists but authentication.x509.clientCAFile is unset or empty. Without a client CA the kubelet cannot verify x509 client certificates, so the API server's kubelet client identity cannot be authenticated and the kubelet API falls back to weaker or anonymous authentication.
archived_checks.description: Flags a supplied kubelet configuration whose authentication block exists but authentication.x509.clientCAFile is unset or empty. Without a client CA the kubelet cannot verify x509 client certificates, so the API server's kubelet client identity cannot be authenticated and the kubelet API falls back to weaker or anonymous authentication.
archived_checks.pass_when: authentication.x509.clientCAFile is a non-empty path.
archived_checks.fail_when: authentication is present but x509.clientCAFile is missing or empty.
archived_checks.not_applicable_when: When the configuration describes a component other than kubelet; a configuration without an authentication block is MANUAL.

archived_checks.title: Kubelet streaming connection idle timeout is not zero
archived_checks.remediation: Set streamingConnectionIdleTimeout to a non-zero duration (for example 4h0m0s).
archived_checks.rationale: Flags a supplied kubelet configuration whose streamingConnectionIdleTimeout is a Go duration where every numeric part is zero (e.g. '0' or '0s'). A zero timeout disables idle cut-off for exec/attach/port-forward streams, letting abandoned or hijacked interactive sessions stay open indefinitely and exhausting kubelet resources.

archived_checks.pass_when: streamingConnectionIdleTimeout is a valid duration with a non-zero component (e.g. 4h0m0s).
archived_checks.fail_when: streamingConnectionIdleTimeout evaluates to zero.
archived_checks.not_applicable_when: When the configuration is not for kubelet; an absent field is MANUAL.

archived_checks.title: Kubelet TLS cipher suites are limited to strong ciphers
frameworks: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes

controls.framework: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes

archived_checks.remediation: Restrict tlsCipherSuites to the CIS strong-cipher list.
archived_checks.rationale: Flags a supplied kubelet configuration whose tlsCipherSuites list is empty or contains any suite outside the CIS strong set (six ECDHE AES-GCM/CHACHA20 suites plus TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128/256_GCM). Weak suites such as 3DES or CBC-SHA let a network attacker downgrade or decrypt kubelet API traffic that carries exec streams and Pod logs.

Weak suites such as 3DES or CBC-SHA let a network attacker downgrade or decrypt kubelet API traffic that carries exec streams and Pod logs.
archived_checks.pass_when: tlsCipherSuites is non-empty and every entry is in the strong-cipher allow-list.
archived_checks.fail_when: tlsCipherSuites is empty or contains a suite not on the allow-list.
archived_checks.not_applicable_when: When the configuration is not for kubelet; an absent tlsCipherSuites field is MANUAL.

archived_checks.title: Kubelet serving certificate and key are declared (or server TLS bootstrap is used)
frameworks: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes

controls.framework: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes

archived_checks.remediation: Declare tlsCertFile and tlsPrivateKeyFile, or enable serverTLSBootstrap with approved CSR signing.
archived_checks.rationale: Flags a supplied kubelet configuration that declares only one of tlsCertFile/tlsPrivateKeyFile while serverTLSBootstrap is not enabled. A half-configured serving certificate means the kubelet falls back to a self-signed certificate that clients cannot verify, enabling man-in-the-middle of kubelet API traffic.

A half-configured serving certificate means the kubelet falls back to a self-signed certificate that clients cannot verify, enabling man-in-the-middle of kubelet API traffic.
archived_checks.pass_when: serverTLSBootstrap is true, or both tlsCertFile and tlsPrivateKeyFile are non-empty.
archived_checks.fail_when: Exactly one of tlsCertFile/tlsPrivateKeyFile is declared and serverTLSBootstrap is not true.

archived_checks.title: kubelet.conf permissions are 600 or more restrictive
archived_checks.remediation: Set the file mode to 600 or more restrictive (chmod 600 /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf).
archived_checks.rationale: Flags operator-supplied file metadata for /etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf when its mode has any permission bit outside 0600 (group/other bits, execute, or setuid/setgid/sticky). This file is the kubelet kubeconfig, which holds the node's API client credentials; group- or world-accessible modes let other local users read secrets or tamper with kubelet behaviour.

archived_checks.remediation: Add or edit a rule in the AWS Backup plan so its schedule creates recovery points at least as often as the approved interval and its lifecycle keeps them 35 days or longer, and declare that interval as scan policy.
archived_checks.rationale: Evaluates each collected AWS Backup plan in its audited account/Region for at least one rule whose cron schedule creates recovery points at least as often as the operator-declared interval and whose lifecycle keeps them at least 35 days; without such a rule the plan cannot meet the backup frequency and 35-day retention objective. archived_checks.remediation: Create designated Cloud KMS keys with protectionLevel=HSM, or approved EXTERNAL_VPC, and migrate protected workloads.
archived_checks.rationale: Checks an explicitly designated Cloud KMS key primary protection level against HSM, with EXTERNAL_VPC accepted only for an explicitly approved key. A complete same-project collection and exact resource identity are required. Missing, partial, malformed, foreign-scope, or unreadable facts return UNKNOWN. Missing designation policy or primary metadata returns UNKNOWN.
archived_checks.description: Checks an explicitly designated Cloud KMS key primary protection level against HSM, with EXTERNAL_VPC accepted only for an explicitly approved key. A complete same-project collection and exact resource identity are required. Missing, partial, malformed, foreign-scope, or unreadable facts return UNKNOWN. Missing designation policy or primary metadata returns UNKNOWN.
archived_checks.fail_when: The designated key primary has another recognized protection level.
archived_checks.not_applicable_when: The key is outside the designated HSM key set.
archived_checks.pass_when: The designated key primary is HSM, or approved EXTERNAL_VPC.

archived_checks.title: KMS key version uses an unapproved algorithm
archived_checks.remediation: Rotate ENABLED KMS key versions using an algorithm in approved_algorithms and disable unapproved versions.
archived_checks.rationale: Compares a recognized Cloud KMS v1 algorithm on an ENABLED version with the explicit project-bound approved_algorithms list, including a deliberately empty list. Unspecified or unrecognized algorithms and malformed version identities return UNKNOWN. Recognized non-ENABLED states are not applicable. No cryptographic operation is performed.
archived_checks.description: Compares a recognized Cloud KMS v1 algorithm on an ENABLED version with the explicit project-bound approved_algorithms list, including a deliberately empty list. Unspecified or unrecognized algorithms and malformed version identities return UNKNOWN. Recognized non-ENABLED states are not applicable. No cryptographic operation is performed.
archived_checks.fail_when: An ENABLED version uses an algorithm outside the approved list.
archived_checks.not_applicable_when: The version is in a recognized state other than ENABLED.
archived_checks.pass_when: An ENABLED version uses an approved algorithm.

archived_checks.title: Artifact repository lacks age-based cleanup
archived_checks.remediation: Add an Artifact Registry DELETE cleanupPolicy with an age condition at or below the approved max_artifact_age and disable dry run.
archived_checks.rationale: Checks for at least one DELETE cleanup policy with olderThan at or below max_artifact_age and cleanupPolicyDryRun=false. On a full representation, omitted dry-run means false and omitted cleanupPolicies means no policies. Valid DELETE conditions without olderThan do not qualify; malformed policy actions, unions, durations or known selectors return UNKNOWN. This existential declaration check does not prove that KEEP rules or other condition filters permit deletion of every old artifact.
archived_checks.description: Checks for at least one DELETE cleanup policy with olderThan at or below max_artifact_age and cleanupPolicyDryRun=false. On a full representation, omitted dry-run means false and omitted cleanupPolicies means no policies. Valid DELETE conditions without olderThan do not qualify; malformed policy actions, unions, durations or known selectors return UNKNOWN. This existential declaration check does not prove that KEEP rules or other condition filters permit deletion of every old artifact.
archived_checks.fail_when: Dry run is true or no policy qualifies in the complete policy map.
evaluated: artifact_repository.cleanupPolicies map action and condition.olderThan Duration
archived_checks.pass_when: Dry run is false and at least one valid DELETE policy has olderThan at or below the configured maximum.

archived_checks.title: VM uses an unapproved image
archived_checks.remediation: Replace the VM boot disk with an image from approved_image_projects, then verify its disk.sourceImage.
archived_checks.rationale: Checks VM boot disk source, complete disk inventory sourceImage and approved_image_projects. The joined boot disk image project is outside the approved list. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
archived_checks.description: Checks VM boot disk source, complete disk inventory sourceImage and approved_image_projects. The joined boot disk image project is outside the approved list. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
archived_checks.fail_when: The joined boot disk image project is outside the approved list.
evaluated: VM boot disk source, complete disk inventory sourceImage and approved_image_projects
archived_checks.pass_when: The joined boot disk image project is approved.

archived_checks.title: VPC automatically creates regional subnetworks where required
archived_checks.remediation: Set autoCreateSubnetworks=true on the VPC only if automatic regional subnet creation is the approved network design.
archived_checks.rationale: Checks VPC selfLink, autoCreateSubnetworks and approved auto_subnet_vpcs. An in-scope VPC explicitly disables automatic subnetworks. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
archived_checks.description: Checks VPC selfLink, autoCreateSubnetworks and approved auto_subnet_vpcs. An in-scope VPC explicitly disables automatic subnetworks. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
archived_checks.fail_when: An in-scope VPC explicitly disables automatic subnetworks.
evaluated: VPC selfLink, autoCreateSubnetworks and approved auto_subnet_vpcs
archived_checks.not_applicable_when: The VPC is outside the approved automatic subnet scope.
archived_checks.pass_when: An in-scope VPC explicitly enables automatic subnetworks.

archived_checks.title: VPC peers with an unapproved network
archived_checks.remediation: Delete unapproved ACTIVE VPC peerings or add only vetted peer networks to approved_peer_networks.
archived_checks.rationale: Checks Complete network peerings network/state and approved_peer_networks. An ACTIVE peering target is outside the allowlist. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
archived_checks.description: Checks Complete network peerings network/state and approved_peer_networks. An ACTIVE peering target is outside the allowlist. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
archived_checks.fail_when: An ACTIVE peering target is outside the allowlist.
evaluated: Complete network peerings network/state and approved_peer_networks
archived_checks.pass_when: Every ACTIVE peering target is approved.

archived_checks.title: Cloud Build trigger accepts unapproved source
archived_checks.remediation: Restrict enabled Cloud Build trigger repository selectors and serviceAccount to the approved source and identity lists.
archived_checks.rationale: On a full enabled trigger, resolves exactly one declared triggerTemplate, github or repositoryEventConfig source and compares it and serviceAccount with two explicit project-bound allowlists. triggerTemplate.projectId omission uses this project, as documented. A source or account outside its allowlist fails; both approved pass. Disabled triggers are not applicable; missing identities, conflicting selectors or incomplete facts return UNKNOWN. This does not evaluate revision regexes or actual build execution.
archived_checks.description: On a full enabled trigger, resolves exactly one declared triggerTemplate, github or repositoryEventConfig source and compares it and serviceAccount with two explicit project-bound allowlists. triggerTemplate.projectId omission uses this project, as documented. A source or account outside its allowlist fails; both approved pass. Disabled triggers are not applicable; missing identities, conflicting selectors or incomplete facts return UNKNOWN. This does not evaluate revision regexes or actual build execution.
archived_checks.fail_when: The enabled trigger source or build account is outside its allowlist.
evaluated: Full trigger repository selector, serviceAccount and two approved allowlists
archived_checks.not_applicable_when: The trigger is disabled.
archived_checks.pass_when: The enabled trigger has one approved source and an approved build account.

archived_checks.title: Resource location is not approved
archived_checks.remediation: Move resources to an approved location or update the approved_locations policy for explicitly authorized regions.
archived_checks.rationale: Checks Cloud asset name, assetType, location and approved_locations. Asset location is outside the approved list. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
archived_checks.description: Checks Cloud asset name, assetType, location and approved_locations. Asset location is outside the approved list. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
archived_checks.fail_when: Asset location is outside the approved list.
evaluated: Cloud asset name, assetType, location and approved_locations
archived_checks.pass_when: Asset location is in the approved list.

archived_checks.title: Cloud asset lacks inventory labels
archived_checks.remediation: Add required owner, criticality and data_classification labels to each in-scope Cloud Asset resource.
archived_checks.rationale: Checks Cloud asset labels and required_label_keys policy. At least one required label is absent or empty. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
archived_checks.description: Checks Cloud asset labels and required_label_keys policy. At least one required label is absent or empty. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
archived_checks.fail_when: At least one required label is absent or empty.
evaluated: Cloud asset labels and required_label_keys policy
archived_checks.pass_when: Every required label key has a nonempty string value.

archived_checks.title: GKE legacy client-certificate issuance requires policy review
archived_checks.remediation: Review legacy certificate authentication with the cluster owner and use modern GKE authentication; do not enable certificate issuance solely for this historical control.
archived_checks.rationale: Checks GKE masterAuth.clientCertificateConfig.issueClientCertificate and owner-approved exceptions. Issuance is enabled without a listed exception. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
archived_checks.description: Checks GKE masterAuth.clientCertificateConfig.issueClientCertificate and owner-approved exceptions. Issuance is enabled without a listed exception. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
archived_checks.fail_when: Issuance is enabled without a listed exception.
archived_checks.pass_when: Issuance is disabled, or enabled only under a listed exception.

archived_checks.remediation: Attach an SSL policy with approved minTlsVersion and cipher profile to every in-scope target HTTPS/SSL proxy.
archived_checks.rationale: Resolves a target proxy sslPolicy against the complete same-project SSL policy inventory. A CUSTOM policy must have a recognized minimum TLS version and nonempty customFeatures, compared with explicit approved bounds. Below-bound TLS or any unapproved feature fails. Empty features, built-in profile expansion, missing policy or malformed bounds return UNKNOWN. Runtime TLS negotiation is not tested.
archived_checks.description: Resolves a target proxy sslPolicy against the complete same-project SSL policy inventory. A CUSTOM policy must have a recognized minimum TLS version and nonempty customFeatures, compared with explicit approved bounds. Below-bound TLS or any unapproved feature fails. Empty features, built-in profile expansion, missing policy or malformed bounds return UNKNOWN. Runtime TLS negotiation is not tested.
archived_checks.fail_when: CUSTOM policy minimum TLS is below the bound or has an unapproved custom cipher.
evaluated: Target proxy sslPolicy, joined CUSTOM SSL policy minimum TLS/customFeatures, approved bounds
archived_checks.pass_when: CUSTOM policy minimum TLS and every custom cipher satisfy approved bounds.

archived_checks.remediation: Move production and nonproduction VMs to separate approved subnetworks using Compute networkInterfaces settings.
archived_checks.rationale: For a VPC listed in segregated_vpcs, checks complete same-project instance facts and each attached interface with matching network. Production and nonproduction sharing a declared subnetwork fails; otherwise passes. Empty VM interface inventories, missing subnetwork identities or unclassified connected VMs return UNKNOWN. Other VPCs are not applicable. This checks logical subnet declarations only, not isolation enforcement or physical separation.
archived_checks.description: For a VPC listed in segregated_vpcs, checks complete same-project instance facts and each attached interface with matching network. Production and nonproduction sharing a declared subnetwork fails; otherwise passes. Empty VM interface inventories, missing subnetwork identities or unclassified connected VMs return UNKNOWN. Other VPCs are not applicable. This checks logical subnet declarations only, not isolation enforcement or physical separation.
archived_checks.fail_when: For this in-scope VPC, a production and nonproduction VM interface share a subnetwork.
evaluated: Complete same-scope network and instance inventories, VM labels.env and networkInterfaces.network/subnetwork, scoped segregated_vpcs policy
archived_checks.not_applicable_when: The VPC is outside the approved segregation scope.
archived_checks.pass_when: For this in-scope VPC, no production and nonproduction VM interface shares a subnetwork.

archived_checks.remediation: Update the approved topology register for observed VPC, subnet and firewall names/regions, or restore missing resources.
archived_checks.rationale: Checks all entries in the project-bound topology register against complete same-project network, subnetwork and firewall inventories. A missing registered asset or a declared network/region mismatch fails; all matching entries pass. Register kind/name and required network/region fields are validated before absence can produce FAIL. Missing, empty or malformed registers and unresolved inventory completeness return UNKNOWN. The verdict covers the whole project register and can repeat for each network; unregistered assets are not evaluated.
archived_checks.description: Checks all entries in the project-bound topology register against complete same-project network, subnetwork and firewall inventories. A missing registered asset or a declared network/region mismatch fails; all matching entries pass. Register kind/name and required network/region fields are validated before absence can produce FAIL. Missing, empty or malformed registers and unresolved inventory completeness return UNKNOWN. The verdict covers the whole project register and can repeat for each network; unregistered assets are not evaluated.
archived_checks.fail_when: A registered asset is absent or its network or region differs from the register.
evaluated: Complete same-scope network, subnetwork and firewall inventories, and topology_register kind/name/network/region
archived_checks.pass_when: Every register entry exists and its network and region relationships agree with current metadata.

archived_checks.description: Compares resource-role-principal tuples on Cloud Asset IAM search results with an explicit project-bound approved roster. archived_checks.remediation: Review the signed proposed specification and remediate the observed grant or event.
archived_checks.rationale: Requires a complete, same-project snapshot collection and valid native identities; incomplete, malformed, missing, or foreign-scope facts yield UNKNOWN. After an approved immediate-deletion deadline, checks only bucket-level recovery settings. Object-level deletion, sanitization, and other storage products are outside this evidence. Missing policy, timing, or recovery fields yield UNKNOWN.
archived_checks.description: Requires a complete, same-project snapshot collection and valid native identities; incomplete, malformed, missing, or foreign-scope facts yield UNKNOWN. After an approved immediate-deletion deadline, checks only bucket-level recovery settings. Object-level deletion, sanitization, and other storage products are outside this evidence. archived_checks.not_applicable_when: No approved immediate-deletion rule applies, or its deadline has not passed.
archived_checks.pass_when: The approved immediate-deletion deadline has passed and all three recovery settings are zero or disabled.

archived_checks.remediation: Attach a Cloud Armor securityPolicy to each in-scope admin backend and add the approved WAF expression/action rule.
archived_checks.rationale: Checks an explicitly approved, topology-verified internet-reachable admin backend against complete Cloud Armor rules. Missing admin mapping, route inventories, rule details or approved expression/action remain UNKNOWN.
archived_checks.description: Checks an explicitly approved, topology-verified internet-reachable admin backend against complete Cloud Armor rules. Missing admin mapping, route inventories, rule details or approved expression/action remain UNKNOWN.

archived_checks.title: Load balancer allows callers outside approved CIDRs
archived_checks.remediation: Add a Cloud Armor DENY rule for sources outside approved_cidrs on each internet-facing backend security policy.
archived_checks.rationale: Checks a policy attached to a proven public backend for an enabled DENY rule with the exact reviewed expression for approved CIDRs. Missing CIDR review or verified precedence remains UNKNOWN.
archived_checks.description: Checks a policy attached to a proven public backend for an enabled DENY rule with the exact reviewed expression for approved CIDRs. Missing CIDR review or verified precedence remains UNKNOWN.
archived_checks.fail_when: A complete precedence-verified policy lacks the exact approved outside-CIDR DENY rule.
evaluated: rules priority, action, disabled and match expression
archived_checks.not_applicable_when: No proven internet-facing backend attaches the policy.
archived_checks.pass_when: A complete precedence-verified policy has that enabled rule.

archived_checks.title: Public backend lacks request rate limiting
archived_checks.remediation: Add a Cloud Armor throttle or rate-based-ban rule at 2000 requests/300 seconds or less with banDurationSec >=60.
archived_checks.rationale: Checks a policy attached to a proven public backend for an enabled matching per-client throttle or rate-based ban rule. Missing backend association, precedence, client key or match policy remains UNKNOWN.
archived_checks.description: Checks a policy attached to a proven public backend for an enabled matching per-client throttle or rate-based ban rule. Missing backend association, precedence, client key or match policy remains UNKNOWN.
archived_checks.fail_when: No matching enabled rule has count <=2000, intervalSec <=300 and banDurationSec >=60 on the approved client key.
evaluated: rules priority, action, disabled, match expression and rateLimitOptions
archived_checks.not_applicable_when: No proven internet-facing backend attaches the policy.
archived_checks.pass_when: A matching enabled rule meets all three thresholds on the approved key.

archived_checks.rationale: Checks CDN-enabled sensitive backends against a project-bound approved cache mode and maximum client/default TTL. Missing sensitivity, policy or CDN fields remain UNKNOWN.
archived_checks.description: Checks CDN-enabled sensitive backends against a project-bound approved cache mode and maximum client/default TTL. Missing sensitivity, policy or CDN fields remain UNKNOWN.
archived_checks.fail_when: A sensitive CDN-enabled backend has a cache mode outside the approved modes or either TTL exceeds its approved maximum.
archived_checks.not_applicable_when: Backend is outside the sensitive list or CDN is disabled.

spec.title: Running Linux VM launch configuration has no SSH public key
